faq.q: How do I choose which side of the train to sit on?
faq.a: Open a route to see the side for each direction. Every side comes from our terrain model of the line; where a published source agrees, the page says so, and where it does not, the answer is marked as model-only. When a river, gorge or mountain changes sides, the route timeline shows the sections in order.

faq.q: Are the seat letters the same on every train?
faq.a: No. These guides give left or right first. A seat letter appears only where it has been verified for that train and direction.

faq.q: Are seasonal trains and views guaranteed?
faq.a: No. Operating days, weather, flowers, autumn colour, snow and drift ice can change. Each card shows the season and any operating note available in the route data.
